title: Property Credit on a Hotel Rate Plans Reservation: Grant, Use and Lapse
content:
This note governs the property credit a Hotel Rate Plans plan includes. Its opening clause has been withdrawn and is marked as such.

> **Withdrawn.** *"Property credit included in the rate plan is placed on the reservation at check-in, for the plan's amount per stay and not per night."* — this clause is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded on the question of what credit stands on a reservation and how it is measured.

**1. When credit may be spent.** Property credit is spent only while the reservation record stands at checked in. The reservation record is the authority for that standing.

**2. What it may be spent on.** The credit is spent against charges taken at the property during the stay and against nothing else; it is never spent on the room rate, on taxes or on the agency service fee.

**3. When it lapses.** The credit lapses at the end of the plan's validity term counted from the arrival date, and whatever is unspent at departure is forfeited without payment.

**4. Who may spend it.** Where the plan allows it, a companion sharing the room may spend the credit; otherwise only the lead guest may.

**5. Plans that grant nothing, and no second grant.** A plan whose credit amount is zero grants no credit at all, and no credit is ever granted twice on one reservation.

## What the credit reaches

| Charge | The credit may be spent against it |
| --- | --- |
| Charges taken at the property during the stay | yes |
| The room rate | no |
| Taxes | no |
| The agency service fee | no |

## A question this note answers

*A companion in the room wants to settle their bar bill from the credit on a plan that does not allow it.* Only the lead guest may spend the credit on such a plan. Where the plan does allow it, a companion sharing the room may.

*The guest departs with credit unspent and asks for it in money.* Whatever is unspent at departure is forfeited without payment.

superseded_clauses: Property credit included in the rate plan is placed on the reservation at check-in, for the plan's amount per stay and not per night.
